items.title: Switch — SoundCloud + YouTube upload package
items.summary: Approving this queues the Switch instrumental (ISΛRK × 10k.emraan, 186 bpm, C min, drill) for manual upload to SoundCloud and YouTube, scheduled to go public on 2026-07-18. The package includes: metadata, upload description, pre-upload checklist, social captions for Instagram/X and YouTube community post, and an art direction prompt for cover/thumbnail production. No files are published automatically — all uploads and posts are manual steps listed in checklist.md.

items.title: Switch W25 collab-story post — X (+ optional IG/TikTok caption variant)
items.summary: Approving this queues a companion X post for the W25 'signal' week of the Switch pre-release arc, leading with the ISΛRK x 10k.emraan collab as the headline ('two producers. one 186 bpm idea...'), plus an alternate collab-forward caption variant for the producer-tag hook clip IG/TikTok post. No link, no store URL, no publish-time claim — text and BPM/key/date facts only, all verified against metadata.json and the Q3 release calendar. Does not require Aether's hook-moment timestamp. Posting both this and the existing W25 X marker post would run one X post over the arc's planned W25 cadence (1) — flagged for Hemera/ISARK to decide before scheduling.
